title: Region dropdown on NewTopicPage

context_files.reason: Pure functions, immutability for form state

acceptance_criteria: NewTopicPage: new optional dropdown field 'Region' with options: Africa, Asia, Europe, Americas, Oceania, Global (default: Global)
Dropdown uses same styling as existing form fields (surface-lighter bg, border, rounded, etc.)
Selected region stored as a string tag appended to the topic's tags array (e.g. 'region:asia') — NO schema column needed
Region tag is filterable like other tags on ForumPage
Region tag renders as a styled chip on topic cards (distinct color from regular tags, e.g. accent-blue bg)
Dropdown is optional — empty selection means no region tag added
Form state uses useState with explicit string type
